mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RESIDENTIAL excess time (8.0 to 5.6 over four weeks) reflects households spending less time at home, which releases pent-up demand for shopping and leisure trips, pushing RETAIL_REC higher once RESIDENTIAL drops below a 5-point threshold.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below +5.0 points above baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the two weeks following RESIDENTIAL crossing below +5.0, or RESIDENTIAL falls further while RETAIL_REC stagnates or declines.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved only -36.1 to -35.3 over the last two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT remains flat within the stated band, rejecting the transit-dependency mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT together signals a compounding recovery of out-of-home routine activity: commuting enables transit-adjacent retail visits, so simultaneous positive momentum in both series amplifies RETAIL_REC growth beyond what either series alone would predict.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC growth rate over the next 4 weeks is not higher than the sum of growth rates predicted from WORKPLACES and TRANSIT individually, indicating no synergistic interaction.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-September to mid-October in Delhi precedes the festival shopping season (Navratri/Dussehra/Diwali run-up), and the recent PARKS rebound combined with easing GROCERY_PHARM declines suggests early seasonal outdoor and shopping activity that will further lift RETAIL_REC as festival preparation intensifies.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2020-09-15 precedes Indian festival season
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows no net increase over the next 28 days despite PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM remaining stable or improving, falsifying the seasonal demand mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: The week-on-week improvement in RETAIL_REC has decelerated sharply (deltas of 2.1, 1.1, 0.3 points), indicating behavioral saturation where early reopening demand has been absorbed; this momentum loss predicts a flat-to-declining RETAIL_REC trend over the immediate next week.

evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly deltas shrank from 2.1 to 1.1 to 0.3

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise or stays flat even after a TRANSIT drop exceeding 10 points in a single week, indicating no causal link to renewed restrictions.
